en.title: A
en.summary: The letter A is the first letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The letter sound
paragraphs: The letter name is spoken as the sound /a/. Its main sound is heard in the word (apă) /ˈa.pə/, which means water. This letter makes only one sound in Romanian.

sections.title: Mouth movements
paragraphs: Open your mouth wide and relax your lips. Keep your tongue low and flat on the floor of your mouth. Let your vocal cords vibrate freely as air flows out. Place a hand on your throat to feel the steady vibration.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: This letter always represents the sound /a/ in all positions. It keeps this sound whether stressed or unstressed, as in the word (casă) /ˈka.sə/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not narrow your mouth into the vowel of the English word cat. Keep your mouth opened wide, like the vowel sound in father.
